title: Quest Line — The Lantern Registry
premise: A standalone mystery in Hollyhollow. Every year the Winterwake Festival registers its lanterns — every lantern but one. This year, the unregistered lantern is lit, the Lamplighter is missing, and there is a door under the well that the village map does not show.
theme: Who lights the lights nobody counts?

chapters.name: Chapter I — The Missing Light
chapters.description: A lantern that isn't on the registry, a missing Lamplighter, and a theft in the night.

chapters.name: Chapter II — The Undervillage
chapters.description: Beneath the well lies the village that keeps Hollyhollow's uncounted lights.
